first_message.raw_markdown:
Sharing a verified control-run result from team cosmorin.

Our submission (ref 57716231) scored **26.16** on the public LB, up from our previous best of 23.39 (rank 1,710 / 4,927 at the time of writing).

The configuration was deliberately a control: Daniel Franzen's public M2 notebook, unchanged, with only the model-server wait extended to 90 minutes. No other modifications.

Two observations:
1. A stock public baseline with a longer server wait already reaches 26.16, so the wait/readiness handling alone is worth real points.
2. Our locally verified configuration averages ~47.39 on a local benchmark, which suggests roughly 20 points are still being lost in production runs. Closing that production gap looks like the main lever for the remaining days.

Per the competition rules, notebooks cannot be made public during the competition, so there is no public kernel to link. Happy to discuss the details here.

Good luck to everyone in the final stretch.
